title: Shifted stabilized kernel stalks are compatible power quotients
statement: Let X, I, F, H, alpha, c, S and j satisfy the stabilized kernel image hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-stalk-presentation]. Let Q(d)_n = S_(n+d)/I^(n+1)S_(n+d), with the canonical transitions [lem-weil-pbc-formal-shifted-quotient]. There is b such that for d >= max(c,b), every point x and every germ-compatible unit-stalk identification give an O_(X,x)-module M and linear isomorphisms E_n:(Q(d)_n)_x -> M/J^(n+1)M for all n. For every z at level n+1, E_n((Q(d)_(n+1) -> Q(d)_n)_x(z)) is the canonical reduction of E_(n+1)(z). Here J is the image of the stalk inclusion of I under that identification [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk].

proof.text: Apply the compatible stalk presentation and keep its bound b. For d>=max(c,b), the stalk q_n of S_(n+d) -> Q_n is surjective with kernel J^(n+1) S_(n+d), by cokernel exactness on stalks and the ideal-product stalk formula. The germ-compatible unit-stalk isomorphism obtained by that formula agrees with the input e: check their maps on germs.

Compose q_n with p_(n+d). By Submodule.comap_smul_top_of_surjective its kernel is J^(n+1)M plus ker p_(n+d), hence just J^(n+1)M by the bound. Its surjectivity and the first isomorphism theorem produce E_n. For compatibility lift a section through this composite at n+1. Apply T to the defining cokernel equation for formalModuleQuotientMap and then use compatibility of p. Both quotient classes are represented by the same element of M.

theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_shifted_stalk_model
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H)
    (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj)
    (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l),
      Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) =
        Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op)))
    (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅
      Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op),
      e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) :
    ∃ b : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, max c b ≤ d → ∀ x : X,
      ∀ e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅
          ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x),
      (∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)),
        e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf
          U x hx r) = X.presheaf.germ U x hx r) →
      let T := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x
      let J : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := LinearMap.range (T.map I.toModulesι ≫ e.hom).hom
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x),
        ∃ E : ∀ n : ℕ, T.obj ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).obj (op n)) ≃ₗ[
            X.presheaf.stalk x] (M ⧸ J ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule _ M)),
          ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : T.obj ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).obj (op (n + 1)))),
            E n ((T.map ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).map
              (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)).hom z) =
              Submodule.factorPow J M (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)) (E (n + 1) z)
